label: Ceiling fan

questions.text: How many hours a day does the fan run?
questions.why: Long running wears the motor and bearings.

questions.text: Does the fan wobble or make a clicking sound?
questions.why: Wobble can mean loose fittings or unbalanced blades.

questions.text: Does the power at home often dip, flicker or trip?
questions.why: Unsteady power can damage the electronics.

questions.text: Is the speed regulator working smoothly?
questions.why: A faulty regulator can strain the motor.
Fittings and wiring need to be done properly for safety.

answers.label: An electrician or the brand's technician

questions.text: How often are the blades cleaned?
questions.why: Dust adds weight and unbalances the blades.

care_tips.text: Switch off the fan at the wall and wait for the blades to stop before cleaning them.
care_tips.why: Cleaning a moving or powered fan risks injury and electric shock.

care_tips.text: Don't open the fan motor yourself; leave repairs to the brand's authorised service.
care_tips.why: Inside there are live parts, and opening it can also end the warranty.

care_tips.text: If the fan wobbles or clicks, stop using it and have the fittings checked by an electrician or the brand's service.
care_tips.why: Loose fittings can make a fan fall.

care_tips.text: Have the mounting and wiring checked by a qualified electrician.
care_tips.why: Proper fittings keep the fan secure.

care_tips.text: Wipe the blades gently with a dry cloth.
Have a faulty regulator replaced by an electrician.
care_tips.why: A faulty regulator strains the motor.

care_tips.text: If the power is unsteady, ask an electrician about protection for the circuit.
care_tips.why: Power swings can damage the motor.

reminders.text: Wipe the fan blades (switched off at the wall).
reminders.note: Check your manual for the interval for your model.

risk_factors.question: installed_by
risk_factors.reason: Proper installation keeps the fan secure.

risk_factors.question: power_issues
risk_factors.reason: Power swings can damage the motor.

exclusions_to_look_for: Installation by people the brand has not authorised
